messages.subject: For Benoit Coquart | Digital infrastructure, energy transition and stakeholder strategy
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Marc,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Benoit Coquart, Chief Executive Officer.

Legrand's growth across digital building infrastructure, data centers and energy-transition solutions increasingly intersects with governments, regulators, customers and sustainability priorities. That environment aligns closely with my current leadership responsibilities.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate spans government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory. I also support stakeholder governance around a major industrial renewable-energy and battery-storage platform.

I would welcome a senior discussion about where this combination of government relations, sustainability and infrastructure stakeholder execution might support Legrand's priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Legrand.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
